_doc: Proven paths are LAW for their archetype until a render dethrones them. Reused verbatim — no freelancing, no improvements.

false-triumph-chase.verdict: Julian: 'a country mile better than anything we have ever done'

recipe.structure: 4 shots in one generation, cuts allowed; the cut sits on the loaded spring at maximum bend
recipe.shot_1_chase: handheld pursuit from behind and slightly beside, always a beat late; THREE parallax speeds (foreground rips, midground slides, background drifts); subject passes NAMED landmarks that vanish behind the camera; subject pulls ahead and shrinks then camera surges and he swells; subject drifts off-centre and camera recovers him; foreground stems wipe fully across the lens; body-mechanics language (tilts hard left, careens hard right, altitude bobbing, chest leading)
recipe.shot_2_escalation: three separate readable contacts, each spin visibly larger than the last, never blurred together; ends held on the spring at maximum load
recipe.shot_3_aerial: the stored force becomes a compound gymnastic move; body tucked compact, camera tracks the full arc so every rotation reads
recipe.shot_4_button: landing → beat of stillness → SELF-CHECK (head up, eyes dart, pats chest, finds he is fine) → only then the pride inflates → line delivered flat and certain → pose holds a full beat after the line → cut to the witness, held long
recipe.staging: canon law: Fuzzby frame-LEFT, Zenny frame-RIGHT; the payoff is the held cut to her unmoved face
recipe.references: one line per character with defines + explicit exclusions; instance counts stated; environment plate carries the world so the prompt describes no world of its own
recipe.audio: dialogue inside the beat where it is spoken, in braces, with delivery direction and 'holds a full beat after the line ends'; language declared; music killed; subtitles banned

lessons_embodied: camera behind, never in front of a chased subject
a perfectly tracked subject reads as motionless — write the traversal
put the cut between the load and the release
the check-before-pride beat is where retroactive-intention comedy lives
the punchline lands on the witness, not the poser

recipe.structure: 3 shots. Shot 1 the transfer, CUT BEFORE THE RESULT IS VISIBLE. Shot 2 the reveal in close-up. Shot 3 the verdict, over-the-shoulder onto the reactor.
recipe.withhold: the new feature is never seen in the shot that creates it — the cut is the reveal's setup
recipe.arrival: the chaotic character stays chaotic even in a dialogue beat: launches too hard, overshoots, has to swing back, arrives faster than he can stop. Confidence never makes him competent
recipe.attribute_exclusivity: state the feature's owner AND an explicit exclusion for every other character in frame; repeat the exclusion in the reaction shot ('her face is entirely clean')
recipe.reaction_shot: over-the-shoulder with the new feature as out-of-focus foreground framing, the reactor in sharp focus — the feature and the reaction in one frame
recipe.eye_line: the reactor's eyes track down to the feature, examine it, then travel back up to meet the eyes before the line
recipe.micro_tell: one corner of the mouth tightens almost imperceptibly before the deadpan line — fighting it and nearly losing
recipe.hold: hold on the reactor's face a full beat AFTER the line ends; the length of the stillness is the punchline
recipe.continuity: open from the previous shot's harvested final frame; carry state forward (pollen dusting) and state explicitly what is NOT yet present

lessons_embodied: withhold the reveal across a cut
attribute exclusivity prevents feature bleed between characters
a chaotic character is chaotic in every beat, not only action beats
frame the feature and the reaction together via over-the-shoulder

escalation-into-verdict.finding: ★ THE ARCHETYPES COMPOSE. This beat is false-triumph-chase (escalating contacts, pop-out showman pose, held line) followed by reveal-and-deadpan-verdict (cut to the reactor, eyes travel, micro-turn, held smile). Two banked recipes joined at a cut produced a working beat first time. We have a grammar, not a list of recipes.

recipe.structure: 4 shots: failed correction that makes it worse → escalating contacts into a trap → explosive pop-out into the showman pose and line → cut to the reactor for the emotional turn
recipe.composition_rule: an action archetype may be joined to a reaction archetype at the button; the cut goes after the line has completely finished
recipe.emotional_turn: the reactor's beat is not a single expression but a MOVEMENT between two — an eye-roll that softens into a loving smile. Name both states and the transition between them
recipe.failed_correction: a character's attempt to fix a problem must visibly worsen it, and the character must SEE the evidence on themselves before panicking
